svg.title: WA2 kit preparation — hardware, printed fixtures, connections and MQTT events
svg.desc: Top-down T2 table, rotated to show its 120 by 80 centimetre proportion. Four prototype instrumented bins, PAROL6 robot, prepared-kit tray, independent guard and emergency stop, controller, single-owner host, camera and Raspberry Pi are shown with connection routes. Printed fixtures have P codes and exact part names in the key. Amber dashed paths need a verified hardware interface or adapter. The implemented evidence API produces candidate Robot kit lifecycle events in a durable outbox; configured TLS MQTT is optional and authoritative publishing requires commissioning.

g.text: Independent guard shown schematically · actual swept volume needs assessment
